concerns.activation_gate: BAR-01-BE2 registry repository/API and BAR-01-BE6 frontend handoff pass.
concerns.statement: Navigation, routes, maturity, preview and task links must come from one validated registry.

concerns.activation_gate: BAR-01-BE3 through BE5 healthy and failure fixtures pass.
concerns.statement: Command Center must not show fake PnL, deployment, incident, blocker or healthy-zero values.

concerns.activation_gate: U07 identity, session and RBAC matrix passes.
concerns.statement: Registry permissions are descriptive until U07 server-side identity, session and RBAC enforcement passes.
Current QuantBT numerical metrics and artifacts remain engine-owned and protected by parity tests.

concerns.activation_gate: Configure approved wheel publish secret and verify canonical storage ACL with production reader GID.
concerns.statement: Historical backtest reader code is certified; production publishing secret and canonical reader-group ACL remain open deployment gates.
Planning API and browser-local modes stay visibly distinct; local state is not presented as shared server authority.

concerns.activation_gate: Each owning Unified phase must pass before its feature maturity changes.
concerns.statement: Commissioned Alpha, Data Catalog, Approval, Paper, Sandbox and Live screens cannot expose operational actions before their authoritative backend phases pass.

concerns.activation_gate: BAR-01-BE5 deadline, payload-limit and partial-failure tests pass.
concerns.statement: Command Center summary must remain bounded, concurrent and below the BAR-01 payload and latency budgets.

concerns.activation_gate: The matching Execution Loop phase in PHASE_TRACKER.md must reach PRODUCT_COMPLETE with recorded evidence.
concerns.statement: Execution Loop revision 3 routes are metadata only; every screen remains commissioned until its authority, freshness, query or command contract and operational evidence pass.
